messages:
Sam: FYI - EU customer 'acme-eu' reported a spike of 429s at 11:02. Console shows requests fell back to model=redwood-small-8q and latency dropped but quality bad. Trying to find why routing picked fallback.
Priya: thanks. are those requests hitting quota or matched to a lower tier policy? can you paste the trace id?
Sam: trace=tr_1965432100_1
Sam: here's the trace snippet showing routing headers: `X-Redwood-Region: eu-west1`, `X-Customer-Tier: standard`, `X-Route-Score: 0.42`
Jordan: hmm, standard tier should prefer r-large unless capacity constrained. check fallback reason in decision log (field `fallback_reason`).
Mira: on it. I pulled the decision log for the trace -> `fallback_reason=capacity_index<0.5` and `selected_pool=shared-lowprio`.
Priya: ok so it's capacity signal, not quota. question: why was capacity_index low for eu-west at that time?
Mira: we had a dedicated maintenance window for dedicated pools, autoscaler was slowly scaling up. there are also preemption events on some nodes.
Sam: how visible is that in Console? customer raised ticket -> they want "why was i routed to this model" button.
Jordan: currently we have "trace" page but it only shows final model and headers. minimal decision stack. UX design doc proposal: add 'decision stack' timeline with matched policy, pool metrics (utilization), fallback reason code, and nearest alternative models + costs.
Priya: love that. for implementation: backend needs to emit `routing_decision_chain` array into trace; frontend will render it. any privacy concerns? it's internal metadata only.
Mira: also add short human-readable reason codes for SRE/customer ops: e.g., `capacity_surge`, `quota_exhausted`, `model_unavailable`, `degraded_latency`
Sam: quick patch: can we expose `routing_headers` in the trace UI as a collapsible section, plus a one-click 'open raw decision log' link?
Jordan: yes. I'll add an endpoint `/internal/trace/{id}/decision` that returns the chain + pool snapshot. auth checks apply.
Priya: runtime note: the chain can be large for multi-hop routing. cap to 10 entries and summarize older ones with `...`
Mira: deploy-bot: rolled config to staging to include `fallback_reason` in traces at 16:15 :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: deployment id dpl_1965432200 - routing-agent v2.3.1
Sam: once in staging, can we add a dashboard card? metrics: per-region fallback-rate, per-tier fallback-rate, avg latency delta when fallback happens.
Jordan: I'll add a dashboard named `routing/fallback-telemetry` with those metrics and a panel for top affected customers.
Priya: and add alert: fallback-rate > 6% for 5m in any region -> paged to infra oncall.
Mira: also propose field `chosen_model_variant` and `candidate_models` in trace so we can show alternatives and weights.
Sam: thanks all. next steps: Jordan -> dashboard, Mira -> backend trace payload, Priya -> alerting, me -> UX mock for 'why' button. follow-up tomorrow.
Jordan: noted. ping me when staging trace ready and I'll wire the UI.
Priya: :thumbsup:
Sam: closing loop here, adding thread to product PRD.
